svg.title: Phase 1 request flow — single and bulk generation paths
svg.desc: Two parallel flows: single poster on the left, Excel bulk on the right, both merging at the field split engine and splitting again at output

g.text: Embed query → cosine similarity → return best template JSON (fetched once per batch)
emp_id → reserved · exact match → copy · fuzzy → map once · missing → LLM generates
